Yeah it's been like this for a while now (many many months). I've experienced it myself in the murder 4 map by jar. Kinda trippy when stuff gets overwritten in the instance as this stays there as long as the instance lives.
A temporary, serverside prevention as a mapmaker would be to have a loop overwrite the station ids every few minutes so no harm can be done permanently.
But i heard some people are able to replace more assets in a world than just the station scripts avtr_id, havent seen this yet though.

The real solution is to not even have an endpoint on the client for unsupported "features" like that. Why accepting a remote change of a pedestal at all if this isn't even a game related feature? No endpoint, no problem :)

This has been a problem for quite a while. Only reason why I rarely run into the problem is because I have my own avatars but its still a big issue. And its pretty bad that certain clients can just change the Avatar Ids on the Pedestals to whatever they want. I'm a huge supporter of people modding vrchat but when stuff like this happens its really hard to convince people on the benefits of modded clients. These are the people that make us look bad.

@{5d29c8d33a82346c94bf5e17|full_name}: making a mod api in the first place leads to this shit. give people tools to freaking override any event and action from the vrc client and this happens.

Oh... I think I remember seeing someone change the pedestal in the hub world. It seems to be a stream injection as only those who were present when it was set had the altered response. Players who entered later had the correct pedestal.
Something similar also let some people change whose uploaded avatars they saw in their menu.
Apparently they can pretend to be a different person through the avatar upload list, browse that other person’s uploads, then splice the avatar from that list into a pedestal for use.

I'll remove the line since I'm not 100%.

details:
A modified client user was able to overwrite an avatar pedestal in our world (change the avatar ID for others) and other users see the same issue happening as well in their world. Example: https://twitter.com/EngineerNeet/status/1380573991845253122
It's already a security issue that there is even the possibility to do "unsupported" things like remotely changing a pedestal or instantiating stuff on other clients.
Such hidden "features" are only an invitation for client users to do malicious stuff. Ideally, the client would be hardened and not support anything that isn't needed today to leave no place for modded clients to exploit those.
title: [Security] Avatar Pedestals can be changed by modified client for remote clients
